name: LenderLink
reason: Founder friction — offering May dates for meetings, making engagement unnecessarily difficult. Life is too short for reluctant founders. Strong thesis (credit data pipe, 36M records, Philippines market) but the relationship dynamic is the earliest signal of how they'll run the company.

name: Nexacore
reason: Wrong model for the lens. Melanie Hawgood (CEO) is impressive and the domain expertise is genuine (husband worked in insurance last-mile for years). AU contract via The Good Guys and Appliances Online is real traction. But the product is physical operations — drivers, device collection, repair, returns. That's a logistics business, not a pipe. Not raising capital currently. Passed April 2026.

name: Medlo + Doccy
reason: Busy space with big incumbent players (Apt, Paragon, established telehealth platforms). Limited growth ceiling given competition. Telehealth too crowded — don't love the sector. Good founder, wrong market for us.

name: Spektr
reason: Missed it — raised €5M two years ago. Next raise will be too expensive to get meaningful equity. Would have been a strong Watch candidate at earlier stage (serial exit founders, excellent compliance infrastructure thesis).

name: Prelude
reason: Missed it — raised $8M seed. Next raise will be too expensive. Strong flow infrastructure play vs Twilio but we're too late for the right entry price.

name: Chhaya
reason: Geography change — South Asia removed from investment scope. Strong micro-insurance platform and 10x revenue growth, but outside revised geography (SEA, Korea, Japan, Europe, UK, AU/NZ).

name: Chamak
reason: Geography change — South Asia removed from investment scope. Also noted: founder profile concern (recent graduates without deep trade finance background).

name: Cybrilla / Fintech Primitives
reason: Geography change — India removed from investment scope. Strong mutual fund API infrastructure play with SEBI RTA licence and ONDC milestone; would be a Watch candidate if geography fit.

name: Ignosis
reason: Geography change — India removed from investment scope. Strong Account Aggregator infrastructure play on RBI rails, backed by Kunal Shah (CRED) and Razorpay Ventures.

name: Co-architecture
reason: Wrong cohort (founded 2021, outside 2025/2026 filter) and wrong model. Labour marketplace for architects — not a pipe. Once an architect finds a job they leave the platform. Low switching cost, cyclical underlying sector (tied to construction), no recurring revenue mechanism. Skalata backing is a positive quality signal but the model doesn't fit the lens.

name: Zabidou
reason: Hardware/physical inspection — computer vision on production lines. Strong metrics ($172K ARR, $3.4M pipeline, Vossloh deployment) and credible founder, but physical hardware deployment is out of scope. Not a pipe play.

name: Nexobot
reason: Robotics — physical robotic sorting systems for logistics. RaaS model with good margins ($130K ARR, 84% gross margin). Dominic Lindsay is a credible founder. But it's a robot. Hardware is out of scope regardless of the model.
